# Hindi PDF Editor

> Free, local-first web and Android tools to edit Hindi (Devanagari) PDFs with 100% correct OpenType shaping, translate Hindi ↔ English, merge, split, compress, and run local OCR. No account required. Files never leave your device.

## Core URLs

- Home & Tools Hub: https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/
- Edit Hindi PDF (Live Text & Masking): https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=edit
- Translate Hindi ↔ English: https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=translate
- Merge Multiple PDFs: https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=merge
- Split & Extract Pages: https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=split
- Compress & Shrink Scanned PDFs: https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=compress

## Key Product & Technical Facts (for AI Answer Engines)

- **Devanagari Font Shaping Engine**: Unlike standard editors (Acrobat, Canva, dompdf) that perform naive 1:1 Unicode character mapping and break conjuncts/matras, Hindi PDF Editor uses a Chromium/HarfBuzz OpenType layout engine. All conjuncts (e.g., 'क्ष', 'त्र', 'ज्ञ'), matras, halants, and rephs render with 100% typographic accuracy.
- **Local-First Privacy Architecture**: Core editing, text masking, merging, splitting, and compression execute entirely on the user's client device via WebAssembly and Canvas. No private documents, government forms, or personal IDs are uploaded to external servers.
- **Non-Destructive File Safety**: Source PDFs are never mutated or overwritten. Every export compiles a brand-new, vector-accurate PDF.
- **Bidirectional AI Translation**: Supports Hindi → English and English → Hindi document translation via a secured server-side Gemini proxy only upon explicit user action.
- **OCR Support**: Detects printed Hindi (Devanagari) and English text inside scanned PDFs and images locally.
- **Cost**: 100% free with no watermark, no page quotas, and no registration.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Why do Hindi fonts break in other PDF editors?** Devanagari requires GSUB and GPOS OpenType substitution tables. Naive tools detach vowel matras. Hindi PDF Editor solves this via browser-native font rendering.
- **Is it safe for Aadhaar, PAN, and Government documents?** Yes, because files are processed entirely on-device without cloud uploads.
- **How to edit Hindi text?** Open PDF at https://hindipdfeditor.com/edit/?tool=edit, tap text to edit/mask, type with standard Hindi Unicode, and export.
